sn47.38:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these four establishments of mindfulness.
sn47.38:1.3: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.38:1.4: As he dwells thus contemplating the body in the body, the body is fully understood.
sn47.38:1.5: Because the body has been fully understood, the Deathless is realized. “He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings … mind in mind …
sn47.38:4.1: phenomena in phenomena … having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.38:4.2: As he dwells thus contemplating phenomena in phenomena, the phenomena are fully understood.
sn47.38:4.3: Because the phenomena have been fully understood, the Deathless is realized.”
